## general

Project-wide engineering guidelines

This is a TypeScript monorepo managed with pnpm.

- Run `pnpm test` before proposing a change.
- Prefer small, focused modules with one clear responsibility.
- Do not add a dependency when the standard library will do.
- Public API changes must be deliberate and documented.
